FAQ.title: Need
FAQ.subtitle: These are the most common questions from Zidimi users. If you can't find the answer you need, our support team is always ready to help.

q1.a: Yes. All 6 Zidimi products (Cleaner, Driver, Privacy, Password, Backup, Uninstaller) have a free version with full basic features, usable forever. The Pro version extends advanced features like scheduled auto-scan, unlimited driver updates, and large cloud backup capacity at a reasonable price of $8.99/year.

q2.q: Is Zidimi software safe? Does it contain viruses or spyware?
q2.a: Absolutely safe. All Zidimi products are digitally signed with Microsoft Authenticode certificates, scanned for malware by VirusTotal before each release, and comply with GDPR security standards. We also passed the Ernst & Young security audit in 2025. Zidimi never collects personal data without your explicit consent.

q3.q: Which operating systems does Zidimi support? What are the requirements?
q3.a: Zidimi supports Windows 11, Windows 10, Windows 8.1, Windows 8, and Windows 7 (both 32-bit and 64-bit). Requires minimum 1GB RAM, 200MB free disk space, and Internet connection for driver updates. We're also developing a macOS version, expected to launch in Q2 2027.

q4.q: How do I uninstall Zidimi software if I no longer want it?
q4.a: Simply go to Control Panel → Programs and Features (or Settings → Apps on Windows 10/11), select the Zidimi product you want to remove, and click Uninstall. The uninstall process takes less than 30 seconds, leaving no junk files, registry entries, or hidden services. You can also use Zidimi Uninstaller to thoroughly remove other Zidimi products.

q5.q: Can I use Zidimi on multiple computers?
q5.a: The Free version has no computer limit. The Pro version allows activation on up to 3 devices simultaneously with one license key. The Business version can be deployed unlimited within an organization. You can manage and deactivate devices anytime in your Zidimi Account.

q6.q: Does Zidimi support my language? Who do I contact for issues?
q6.a: Yes, Zidimi supports full interface in 24 languages including English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese, French, German. If you encounter any issues, our global support team is available 24/7 via in-app live chat, email support@zidimi.app, or hotline. Average response time under 2 hours during business hours.

q7.q: Does the Pro version auto-renew? Can I cancel anytime?
q7.a: No, Zidimi never auto-renews and doesn't store your credit card. When the Pro license expires, your account automatically switches to Free and you can continue using basic features. You're completely in control of whether to renew. We offer a 30-day unconditional money-back guarantee if you're not satisfied.

q8.q: Where is the safest place to download Zidimi?
q8.a: Only download Zidimi from the official website zidimi.app, Microsoft Store, or official distribution partners listed on the download page. Avoid downloading from unfamiliar websites as they may bundle malware. Each official installer has a Microsoft Authenticode digital signature, which you can verify by right-clicking the file → Properties → Digital Signatures.

longDesc.cleaner: Zidimi Cleaner is an all-in-one PC cleanup tool trusted by 12 million users. With a deep scan algorithm developed specifically for Windows, Zidimi Cleaner can detect over 50 different types of junk files — from browser cache and temporary system files to registry errors accumulated over years of use. Beyond cleaning, the software also optimizes startup, manages background services, and schedules automatic maintenance to keep your computer in peak condition.
longDesc.driver: Zidimi Driver is a comprehensive driver management solution for Windows. With a database of over 5 million official drivers from manufacturers like NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Realtek, and Broadcom, Zidimi Driver ensures you always have the latest and most compatible driver version. The software not only updates drivers but also creates restore points before each update, backs up current drivers for rollback when needed, and automatically checks for updates weekly. Especially useful for gamers who need graphics driver updates to boost FPS and fix stuttering.
longDesc.privacy: Zidimi Privacy is a comprehensive privacy protection toolkit for Windows. In an era where personal data has become a commodity, Zidimi Privacy lets you control exactly what information is shared and what stays private. The software blocks over 10,000 trackers and fingerprinting scripts from popular websites, encrypts sensitive files with AES-256 (the same standard used by banks and military), permanently deletes sensitive files so they cannot be recovered by any recovery software, and monitors application access permissions. Especially useful for users concerned about data safety.
longDesc.password: Zidimi Password is a next-generation password manager with zero-knowledge architecture. Unlike traditional password managers, Zidimi Password never stores your passwords on servers — all data is encrypted on your device before syncing to the cloud. Even Zidimi cannot see your passwords. The software supports smart auto-fill logins across all browsers, generates strong random passwords following NIST standards, syncs safely between Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, and integrates built-in two-factor authentication (2FA) for additional protection of important accounts.
longDesc.backup: Zidimi Backup is a comprehensive backup solution that ensures you never have to worry about losing important data. Whether it's work documents, family photos, or the entire operating system, Zidimi Backup can safely back up to encrypted cloud, external drives, NAS, or network drives. The software supports scheduled backups (daily, weekly, monthly), incremental backups to save space and time, and stores multiple historical versions so you can restore to any point in the past. When disaster strikes, the 1-click restore feature helps you recover data in minutes rather than hours.
longDesc.uninstaller: Zidimi Uninstaller is the most thorough software uninstaller for Windows. When you uninstall apps through the default Control Panel, a lot of junk files are often left behind in AppData, ProgramData, registry, temporary files, and shortcuts. Zidimi Uninstaller deep scans the entire system to find and completely remove every trace of an application. Especially useful for stubborn apps that can't be removed through Control Panel (force uninstall), software bundled with adware/bloatware, and when you want to clean your PC before reinstalling Windows. Supports batch uninstall of multiple apps at once to save time.

cleaner.q1: Is Zidimi Cleaner safe for personal data?
cleaner.a1: Yes. Zidimi Cleaner only deletes system junk files and cache identified as safe. All personal files (documents, photos, videos) in Documents, Pictures, Downloads folders are protected. Plus, the Preview feature lets you see exactly which files will be deleted before confirming.
cleaner.q2: How long does a full system scan take?
cleaner.a2: Scan time depends on disk size and CPU speed. On average, a computer with 256GB SSD takes about 8-15 seconds for a full scan. With 1TB HDD it may take 30-60 seconds. You can continue using the computer during scanning.
cleaner.a3: Yes. Zidimi Cleaner automatically creates a restore point before each cleanup. You can undo all actions within 30 days via the History feature. Deleted files are compressed and stored in Zidimi's Recycle Bin, separate from Windows Recycle Bin.
cleaner.a4: We recommend weekly Quick Scan and monthly Deep Scan. Zidimi Cleaner Pro can auto-schedule — e.g., Quick Scan every Friday, Deep Scan on the 1st of each month — so you don't need to remember manually.

driver.a1: Yes. All drivers in Zidimi's database are downloaded directly from manufacturer official servers (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Realtek, etc.) and are Microsoft WHQL digitally signed. We never distribute modified or beta drivers.
driver.a2: Zidimi Driver always creates a system restore point and backs up old drivers before each update. If a new driver causes issues, you can rollback to the previous version in one click. Update success rate is 99.7%.
driver.a3: Yes, especially good for laptops. Many laptops (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer) have customized OEM drivers different from public drivers. Zidimi identifies your laptop and downloads the correct OEM driver, ensuring function keys (Fn), webcam, fingerprint, audio card all work.
driver.q4: How often are new drivers updated?
driver.a4: Zidimi's driver database is updated daily with newly released drivers from OEMs. The software will automatically check and notify you when new drivers are available for your devices. You can enable Auto-Update for silent background installation.

privacy.q1: Can Zidimi Privacy replace a VPN?
privacy.a1: Not entirely. Zidimi Privacy focuses on protecting local traces on your computer, while VPN encrypts network connections. We recommend using both: Zidimi Privacy for cleaning traces and encrypting files, VPN for hiding IP when browsing. Zidimi Privacy has a light IP hiding feature but doesn't replace a dedicated VPN.
privacy.a2: Not with current technology. Zidimi uses AES-256 — the encryption standard approved by NSA for top secret documents. Brute-forcing one AES-256 file takes about 10^50 years with the fastest supercomputer today. Most important is your password: a 12+ character random password is virtually uncrackable.
privacy.q3: How is permanent deletion different from Shift+Delete?
privacy.a3: Shift+Delete only removes file references; actual data remains on disk and can be recovered by recovery software. Zidimi Privacy permanently deletes by overwriting random data on the storage area multiple times (US DoD 5220.22-M standard), ensuring no recovery is possible by any method.
privacy.a4: Zidimi Privacy fully supports Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi. Auto-detects installed browsers and cleans history, cookies, cache, download history, form data, saved passwords (optional). Can set up whitelist for sites needing to stay logged in.

password.a1: Zero-knowledge is an architecture where Zidimi never knows your master password. The password is used to encrypt data on your device before syncing to the cloud as encrypted. Even if Zidimi's servers were hacked, attackers would only see encrypted data that cannot be decrypted.
password.q2: If I forget my master password, can it be recovered?
password.a2: No. Due to zero-knowledge architecture, Zidimi has no way to recover your master password. This is a necessary security trade-off. Recommendation: write your master password on paper and keep in a safe, or use an easy-to-remember passphrase of 4-5 random words like 'cat-yellow-tree-book-red'.
password.q3: How does sync between Windows and phone work?
password.a3: Download Zidimi Password app on iOS/Android, sign in with the same Zidimi Account. Data will automatically sync via end-to-end encrypted cloud. All changes on Windows appear on phone within seconds. Can use offline and auto-sync when online.
password.a4: Yes. Zidimi Password has official extensions for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera. The extension auto-fills logins when you visit login pages, generates strong passwords when registering new accounts, and saves automatically. Extension communicates with desktop app via local encryption, no internet data sent.

backup.q1: How much cloud storage does Zidimi Backup have?
backup.a1: Free version has 1 GB free cloud forever — enough for important text documents. Pro version expands to 100 GB, Business to 1 TB/team. You can also combine cloud backup + external drive to leverage both.
backup.a2: Zidimi Backup supports all three modes: Full (complete backup), Incremental (only files changed since last backup), and Differential (files changed since last full backup). Default uses Incremental to save space and time. We recommend monthly Full backup + daily Incremental.
backup.a3: Zidimi Backup includes Bootable Rescue Media — you can create a Windows PE bootable USB, boot from USB when Windows is broken, and restore system from backup. Very useful for ransomware, BSOD, or disk errors. This feature is included in Free version.
backup.q4: Does it support Office 365 / Google Drive backup?
backup.a4: Yes. Zidimi Backup Pro can backup email, files and calendar from Office 365, Google Workspace, OneDrive, Google Drive, and Dropbox. Ensures your cloud data is also backed up elsewhere, in case your account is hacked or locked.

uninstaller.q1: How is it different from Control Panel > Programs and Features?
uninstaller.a1: Default Control Panel only runs the app's uninstaller, often leaving many junk files in AppData, ProgramData, registry, temp files, shortcuts. Zidimi Uninstaller deep scans the entire system after uninstalling, finds and removes all traces. Average frees 50-200 MB extra junk per app compared to Control Panel uninstall.
uninstaller.a2: When an app's uninstaller is broken or the app has no uninstaller, Zidimi analyzes the installation file, finds all installed file locations, created registry keys, registered services, then manually removes everything. Effective for 95% of stubborn apps. Before force uninstall, Zidimi always creates a restore point for rollback.
uninstaller.a3: Yes. Zidimi Uninstaller has bloatware detection — pre-installed OEM apps (McAfee Trial, WildTangent, Lenovo App, Dell Digital Delivery, etc.). Auto-lists and allows batch removal in one click. Average new PC has 10-30 bloatware; removing all significantly speeds up the computer.
uninstaller.q4: Can it uninstall Windows Store (UWP) apps?
uninstaller.a4: Yes. Zidimi Uninstaller supports uninstalling both traditional Win32 desktop apps and Windows Store (UWP) apps. Especially useful for removing built-in Windows apps that Control Panel doesn't allow uninstalling (Cortana, Xbox, Mail, Calendar, etc.).
